slides.head:
An AI-made movie got an R rating.
Now it wants an Oscar.
Gods Don’t Give Gifts.
slides.body: A four-story anthology from YouTuber Gossip Goblin and AI studio Fable. Most of its images are AI-generated.

slides.head: In U.S. theaters Dec. 4.
slides.body: Fable pushed it back from Oct. 30 to land closer to awards season.

slides.head: The target: Best Animated Feature.
slides.body: Only one R-rated film has ever been nominated in that category: Anomalisa (2015).

slides.head: The Academy’s rule.
slides.body: Performances must be human. Scripts must be human-written. Using AI alone neither helps nor hurts a film’s chances.

slides.head: “This generation’s Toy Story.”
slides.body: That’s how Fable’s CEO describes it. Early reactions to the trailer are split.
